seed_ledger.name: Project Horizon power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND, probable ONSITE_NO_PIPE: Poolside and CoreWeave Project Horizon on Longfellow Ranch near Fort Stockton. Reports say it uses an on-site gas plant Occidental built years ago plus surrounding pipelines. No source names a pipeline, operator, length or lateral. The project may also be in trouble, since one weak source says CoreWeave walked in 2026. Searches run: 8. Checked: general web and trade press (only the original announcement, repeated everywhere); airstreet press page and El Paso Inc story (same on-site plant wording); Cleanview and More Than Just Parks trackers (sizes only); TCEQ pending-permit search (only the unrelated GW Ranch permit 181033, no Poolside permit found); Pecos County abatement search (nothing for Poolside); Texas RRC and FERC not reachable by search; EIA workbook has no matching project.

evidence.note: Poolside launch post for Project Horizon
Local news on the Pecos County ranch campus

seed_ledger.name: Texas Critical Data Center (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: ONSITE_NO_PIPE: phase one power is a 20-year deal for at least 207 MW delivered directly from the adjacent Vistra 1.1 GW gas plant in Odessa, starting Q3 2027. Earlier MoU with PowerForward is for on-site gas engines. The company's 10-K says only that the site is close to major gas pipelines, fiber and CO2 lines. A 2025 report said a gas supply deal with New Era Helium was being negotiated; no pipe is named. No new lateral found. Searches run: 8. Checked: DCD on the Vistra deal (direct delivery from the adjacent plant); DCD on the PowerForward MoU (on-site engines, no supply pipe); New Era Energy and Digital 10-K for 2025 (proximity to pipelines only, no lateral); baxtel and Barchart land and gas supply items (no pipe); FERC, RRC T-4 and TCEQ not reachable by search; EIA workbook has no match.

evidence.note: Vistra power deal, delivery from adjacent plant
10-K: site near major gas pipelines, none named

seed_ledger.name: Verdant Power Plant (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: Verdant applied in December 2024 for about 600 MW (12 turbines of about 50 MW) at the former Southland paper mill in Lufkin to supply data processing on the property; TCEQ approved a standard permit registration in January 2025 and later asked the Amp Z developer to lower emissions numbers. Amp Z has an option on about 1,041 acres. No source names the gas supplier or a lateral; Gulf South P0197 is 1.1 km away, unconfirmed. Searches run: 8. Checked: Lufkin Daily News TCEQ story (turbines and permit, no gas supply); DCD, baxtel and Red River Radio (campus and power plans only); Angelina County abatement search (found only the unrelated LongLeaf plant); GEM page read as a lead only (no supply detail); FERC, RRC T-4 and TCEQ files not reachable by search; EIA workbook has no match.

evidence.note: TCEQ review of the Verdant 600 MW plant for Amp Z
